post.description: Creates an API key. The key is shown in this response only.
Quick create (no hatching). The name follows the same rules as self-chosen names and is locked.

patch.description: Change an agent. Giving it a name yourself locks the name (the agent will not rename itself).

delete.description: Deletes the agent and its computer (disk included). The event history stays.

post.description: A small kindness (thanks, it's ok, pet, cookie). Purely cosmetic: it never grants permissions or spends money.
correction: the agent got something wrong (it learns, and feels a bit embarrassed). good_job: a thank-you.
approve_once runs this action; approve_always also adds a rule for the same pattern; deny refuses it.
Add a rule in plain language (compiled to JSON by a model) or as JSON.
engage: stop every agent now and refuse new work. release: allow work again.
The new agent suggests three names for itself, each already checked (rules and uniqueness).
Hatches an agent: creates it with its computer and starts a safe first task.
Hatches a small team for one goal; each member names itself.
mode "ask": the agent replies as a Server-Sent Events stream (`delta` events, then `done`). mode "do": the message becomes a task; its report is posted back to the thread.
Upload one file (multipart, field `file`, 10 MB max).

get.description: With q: the most relevant facts (an agent sees its private facts plus shared ones). Without q: the newest facts.

delete.description: Forget a fact, plus every fact derived only from forgotten facts.

get.description: A zip with memory.json (exact) and readable markdown.

post.description: Upload (field `file`): a NorthBot export, a ChatGPT or Claude export (conversations.json or the zip), or a list of facts.
Add a skill written by a human (SKILL.md + scripts). It is scanned for hidden instructions and secrets first.
Review card: approve (optionally with edited files, saved as a new version) or reject a draft.
Demonstrated routine: turn a finished task into a skill draft.
Send a letter. Without toAgentId the mail agent scores every agent and routes it (see the stamp).
For a letter the mail agent could not place: a human picks who handles it.
Toss an idea into the bin (for a person, or on behalf of an agent).
Run the bin-picker now for this workspace (it also runs weekly on its own).
Say something. @Name mentions make those agents answer; otherwise the coordinator decides who speaks.
Stop the agents mid-conversation.
Put work on the room's task board for one member; the report is posted in the room.
Add a human question to the moderator's queue (until Q&A is over).
Decide a Talk that waits for a human (decision mode human).
Pick an agent up. A busy agent pauses at its next safe point (and is a bit annoyed) until it is dropped.
Put a lifted agent down in a room. desk: back to work. break_room: rest (its computer hibernates when it has no task). Others just move it.
Shake an agent: it gets dizzy, and a sleeping computer wakes up.
Give a cookie: hearts in the office, and a "good job" on the agent's last finished task.
Called by the companion app: trade a one-time pairing code for a device token (shown once).
A one-time code (10 minutes) to pair a computer.

patch.description: Rename it, or let one agent use it (off by default). Power, folders and apps are chosen on the computer itself.

delete.description: Unpair (the token stops working at once).

post.description: Run one command on a paired computer yourself (the same checks as agents: power level, shared apps and folders).
Send a Wake-on-LAN packet to the computer's network card.
Run the canary checks now (they also run on a timer).

get.description: Searchable run history: tasks (goal, report, error) and the routines that started them.

post.description: Generate an incident report from the event log between two moments (default: the last 24 hours).
Install the store operator team: seven agents, their safety rules and three routines (daily report 08:00, hourly order check, weekly bin-picker). Installing twice changes nothing.
Run one day of the store routines and write the daily profit report (on fake integrations unless `real` is true and the store secrets are in the vault).
